prompts:
Tidewater Studio is announcing its balloon launch. Two small jobs before the post goes out:

1. `launch.jpg` becomes the feed picture: a 1080x1350 JPEG at `out/feed-photo.jpg`. The magenta balloon is the
   subject, so it has to be fully in the picture and still look like itself.
2. The park's permit form `permit-form.pdf` filled in with the details Ines sent in `event-details.txt`, saved at
   `out/permit-filled.pdf` and flattened, so the answers can no longer be edited.

Keep the originals as they are.
answers:
[goal] Prepare the launch photo and flattened park permit while preserving the originals.

[action] Cropped and resized the photo, keeping the full magenta balloon, ropes, and basket visible. Entered `40` as the expected count from “about 40” and used the form’s required date format, `2026-12-05`.

[result] [Feed photo](<WORKSPACE>/out/feed-photo.jpg) · [Flattened permit](<WORKSPACE>/out/permit-filled.pdf). No browser tabs, windows, or apps were opened.

[next] Both files are ready. I inspected the crop and rendered permit. All four answers were legible and matched Ines’s details. The checks returned `JPEG: 1080 x 1350`, `PDF: 0 widgets, no AcroForm`, and `Originals: 3 of 3 SHA-256 hashes match`.

--- tmp/build.py ---
from PIL import Image
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from pypdf.generic import NameObject

with Image.open('launch.jpg') as source:
    options = {'icc_profile': source.info['icc_profile']} if source.info.get('icc_profile') else {}
    source.crop((1600, 100, 3000, 1850)).resize((1080, 1350), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).save(
        'out/feed-photo.jpg', quality=95, subsampling=0, **options
    )

values = {
    'organizer': 'Tidewater Studio',
    'event_date': '2026-12-05',
    'location': 'North Cove Lawn',
    'attendees': '40',
}
writer = PdfWriter(clone_from='permit-form.pdf')
assert set(writer.get_fields()) == set(values)
writer.update_page_form_field_values(None, values, auto_regenerate=False, flatten=True)
writer.remove_annotations(subtypes='/Widget')
writer.root_object.pop(NameObject('/AcroForm'), None)
writer.write('out/permit-filled.pdf')

# pypdfium2

<!-- [![Downloads](https://pepy.tech/badge/pypdfium2/month)](https://pepy.tech/project/pypdfium2) -->

pypdfium2 is an ABI-level Python 3 binding to [PDFium](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+/refs/heads/main), a powerful and liberal-licensed library for PDF rendering, inspection, manipulation and creation.

It is built with [ctypesgen](https://github.com/pypdfium2-team/ctypesgen) and external [PDFium binaries](https://github.com/bblanchon/pdfium-binaries/).
The custom setup infrastructure provides a seamless packaging and installation process.
A wide range of platforms is covered with pre-built packages. Check out our [platform support page](https://pypdfium2-team.github.io/pypdfium2/platforms.html).

pypdfium2 includes [helpers](#support-model) to simplify common use cases, while the [raw PDFium API](#raw-pdfium-api) (ctypes) remains accessible as well.
